notes: Twelve selected documentary photos/photo pairs and one official combined brand lockup. Every selected image was visually inspected. Existing recovered files are referenced in place; only new files were downloaded into public/assets/editorial/.
The strongest opening image is camras-hardware: real engineers beside a quadruped prototype, rather than the similarly composed painted illustration on the programme site.

Brand PDF page 5 (printed page 4), IISc Co-branding, explicitly approves the combined lockup. Display the complete file at its native aspect ratio on a light background; do not separately resize the seal/wordmark, add a vertical divider, crop the tagline, or recolour parts.

Correction to older recovered labels: recovered artgarage-campus.webp actually shows a drone flying in the lab, not an aerial campus photograph. It duplicates camras-robotics and is not included here. recovered artgarage-equipment.webp shows the building exterior; it is correctly labelled artgarage-exterior in this manifest.

No individual identities, founder status or specific project outcomes were inferred from photographs. Programme-page provenance is recorded; illustrative, stock and AI-generated images were not included as documentary.
The oral-screening asset is an existing two-panel photo on the public programme page, with no text banner. Preserve an accurate screening caption rather than using it as generic decoration.
